primitives.name: Asynchronous Task Queue Manager
primitives.verbatim_quote: - All generation endpoints are async: POST returns `{"result": "<task_id>"}`, then poll `GET <same path>/<task_id>` until `status` is `SUCCEEDED` / `FAILED` / `CANCELED`.
primitives.assumptions: Task execution is non-blocking and idempotent.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When status remains IN_PROGRESS beyond timeout threshold.

layer2.mapping: Maps API responses to GSE state machines for procedural 3D pipeline control.

primitives.name: Meshy Pipeline Fallback Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Meshy API — verified animated-character pipeline (FALLBACK ONLY) > **STOP — check the native CLI path first.** If `image_to_3d` and `3d_rigging` > appear in `higgsfield model list`, do NOT use this raw API and > do NOT ask the user for any API key.
primitives.assumptions: Native CLI provides superior performance and credit usage.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When native tools are unavailable or unsupported.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE's conditional execution logic based on environment availability.

primitives.name: Stuck Refinement Recovery Mechanism
primitives.verbatim_quote: Verified failure mode: a refine stuck at `IN_PROGRESS` `progress: 0` for 1.5 h — a queue jam on Meshy's side.
primitives.assumptions: Queue jams are transient and recoverable through task deletion.

layer2.mapping: Enables GSE resilience against backend failures via task lifecycle management.
layer2.telemetry: Recovery cycle duration and refund eligibility flag.
